summary: Learn AI for marketing, sales and customer engagement with practical workflows, CRM tools, and governance. Book this 5-day course today.
lede: AI training for sales and CRM shows professionals how to apply AI to customer data, campaign work, and sales and service processes. It is for people already working in these workflows who need to segment audiences, draft campaign and customer-response content, and prioritize leads using CRM signals. Learners also practice mapping chatbot escalations, reviewing performance dashboards, and setting human-review and data-privacy checkpoints.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with customer data, campaign workflows, or sales and service processes and now need to apply AI in a practical, controlled way.
audience: Content Strategists using generative AI for message
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and the ability to work with sample campaign, CRM, or customer service data during exercises. Familiarity with digital marketing, CRM dashboards, or customer engagement reporting will help you get more from the workshops, but the course does not require programming.
